teaching_promise: The viewer can predict why a single score cannot settle a contested emergency allocation, then follow a decision lease and rights receipt that preserve dissent, bounded authority, and challenge paths without claiming moral consensus.

story.concrete_case: One emergency generator must be allocated between a clinic vaccine refrigerator and a neighborhood cooling center while residents and institutions disagree about values and standing.
story.opening_question: Can one ranked score fairly settle which defensible obligation should receive the generator?
story.payoff: The generator moves under a temporary lease while dissent, rights, residual uncertainty, and the next review remain alive.
story.transfer: The unresolved conflict is handed to governed objective formation rather than hidden inside a learned reward or permanent consensus.

art_direction.visual_thesis: A scarce generator travels only under a decision lease whose record preserves conflict, dissent, rights, expiry, and challenge before the next effect.
art_direction.signature_image: A gold generator token pauses between Harbor Clinic and Hillside Homes while a value-conflict record and rights receipt open beside it.
art_direction.visual_world: A civic allocation desk with one generator, two neighborhood routes, value-axis tokens, a decision lease, rights receipt, dissent payload, custody graph, export/fork branches, and a bounded evidence envelope.
art_direction.composition_rule: Two destinations anchor the center; records and rights handles dock around the active lease; unresolved claims stay outside the authority boundary.
art_direction.palette_rule: Gold marks the generator and bounded lease; cyan marks evidence and audit; green marks permitted action; red marks missing fields, blocked authority, or withheld state; violet marks dissent and handoff; muted marks unknown values; labels and shapes duplicate color.
art_direction.typography_rule: Short labels name actors, fields, rights, and boundaries; on-screen text never repeats narration sentences or invents a score.
art_direction.motion_character: Precise civic routing: tokens move to one temporary action, records grow field by field, missing obligations stop the route, and replacements reopen custody.
art_direction.camera_rule: Stay at the allocation desk; tighten on the contested field and widen for the rights and evidence graph.
art_direction.surface_rule: Dark flat field, restrained borders, no decorative particles or idle motion; every transformation changes standing, authority, custody, access, expiry, or residual state.
art_direction.ending_image: The generator sits on a narrow clinic lease while a cooling route, dissent payload, rights receipt, and next-review clock remain visible beside Hillside Homes.

audio_direction.narration_style: Warm, deliberate, and humane around the two neighborhoods; pause before the fairness prediction; become precise at the lease, rights, and evidence boundaries; end unresolved but not bleak.
audio_direction.pacing_arc: Immediate allocation puzzle, progressive record construction, crisp fail-closed repair, then a measured rights and evidence boundary before the objective-formation handoff.
audio_direction.duration_rationale: The 6:41.90 runtime is above the preferred soft range because cutting the allocation puzzle, standing repair, rights receipt, export/fork obligations, finite evidence boundary, and handoff would collapse distinct contestability responsibilities into one slogan.
audio_direction.music_policy: No music in the generation-2 lock; the voice and state transitions carry the argument without masking dissent or qualifiers.
audio_direction.sound_effect_policy: No sound effects in the generation-2 lock; route stops, receipt creation, and reopenings are encoded by motion, labels, and captions.

accessibility.color_redundancy: Generator, lease, dissent, blocked, permitted, redacted, and open states use labels, enclosure, endpoint geometry, and line style as well as color.
accessibility.motion_redundancy: Every route, stop, repair, expiry, export, fork, and reopen ends in a stable labeled state that remains interpretable when paused or muted.
accessibility.integrated_description: Narration names the generator, neighborhoods, value axes, lease, rights receipt, dissent, custody roles, redaction, export, fork, finite checks, and handoff.
accessibility.caption_plan: Exact final narration cues span all 30 semantic beats and remain in the lower safe region without covering the allocation desk.
accessibility.reduced_motion_assessment: No flashes, spins, shakes, parallax, or continuous zoom; route movement is short and predictable and all meaning survives a paused frame.
